verdict.rationale: Okta documents an Integrator Free Plan for testing code and apps, which implies a separate test org. It also offers a free, hosted Cross App Access playground for exploring agent-to-app flows end to end with no infrastructure to set up. Both are the product's own testing environments, but the evidence is thin. Neither item explicitly says it is isolated from production data, and the playground covers only one feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox or test orgs are isolated from production, a full-featured sandbox or preview environment beyond the XAA playground, a way to point agents or the MCP server at a sandbox, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
